lead: A code change comparison: give it two texts (or a unified diff) and it shows the added, removed and unchanged lines with old and new line numbers. The header has the file name and +n −m stats, and unchanged lines far from any change are folded into one bar. Additions and removals have a + / − sign and a screen reader prefix besides their background, so color isn't the only cue.

patch.title: Unified patch
patch.description: Pass the output of `git diff` as is: the file header is ignored and line numbers come from the `@@` lines.

collapsed.title: Collapsed context
collapsed.description: Unchanged lines between and around the changes are folded; click the bar to expand them.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.description: The functions DiffView is built on are exported too, for your own rendering.
helpers.diffLines: Compares two texts line by line (LCS)
helpers.parsePatch: Parses a unified diff, ignoring the file header and numbering lines from the `@@` headers
helpers.collapse: Folds unchanged lines further than `context` lines from a change into gaps

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.header: The header and the file name
styling.stats: The added / removed counts; `data-type` of `diff-stat` is add / del
styling.scroll: The focusable, horizontally scrollable code area
styling.row: A line; `data-type`: add / del / ctx / gap (the row holding a fold bar)
styling.gutter: The two columns of old / new line numbers
styling.label: The "Added: / Removed: " prefix, for screen readers only, visually hidden
styling.gap: The fold bar and the expand button in it
styling.token: A highlighted piece, same values as CodeBlock (keyword / string / number…)
